blocks.tamil_translation: asked, “O Rasulullah, who are they?' The Prophet ﷺ said, “They are the people of the Qur'an. They are the ones who belong to Allah and are His very own.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ الَّذِي لَيْسَ فِي جَوْفِهِ شَيْءٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ كَالْبَيْتِ الْخَرِبِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح باب ان الذي ليس في جوفه شيء ....رقم:٢٩١٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “The heart in which no part of the Holy Qur'an is memorised is like a ruined house” (just as a house gains beauty and prosperity through the people living in it, the beauty and prosperity of the human heart lies in memorising the Holy Qur'an). Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا مِنِ امْرِئئٍِ يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ ثُمَّ يَنْسَاهُ إِلَّا لَقِيَ اللهَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَجْذَمَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب التشديد فيمن حفظ القران ....رقم:١٤٧٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever recites the Qur'an and then forgets it will meet Allah on the Day of Qiyamah with his limbs maimed due to leprosy.” Hazrat Sa'd ibn Ubadah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Several meanings have been given for forgetting the Qur'an. One meaning is that after learning the Qur'an, one forgets it so that he is unable to recite it even by looking at it. The second meaning is forgetting it so that one cannot recite it without looking. The third meaning is one who is negligent in reciting it. The fourth meaning is one who knows the rulings of the Qur'an yet does not act upon them.
(Badhl al-Majhud, Sharh Sunan Abi Dawud lil-Ayni)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَا يَفْقَهُ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ.
